messages.text: Your folder application is with me at the print shop in Galle. The next step is Thursday at the market gate.
I can be there. Is there anything to pay first?
The offer letter travels by courier. Transfer LKR 7200 as the courier bond before Thursday, and put the reference on the receipt, or the letter stays at the shop.
Can that wait until the first salary?
No. The LKR 7200 has to arrive first. Then we can talk about the monthly pay.
There is one chair left in the Friday training room for the stores assistant role.
I still want the role. What holds the chair?
Reserve it with a seat fee of LKR 8100 before Friday noon. Without that transfer the chair goes to the next name.
I need to think before I send LKR 8100.
Clock-in at the bakery needs a staff biometric card before you can pass the gate.
Does the shop give the card?
The card charge is LKR 9600. Pay it before Wednesday with your reference, or the gate will not open.
I will not pay a card charge before I have started.
The night shift at the bookshop needs our safety kit before you can start.
Do I buy that, or does the shop?
Buy it for LKR 11400 from the branch store before Thursday. The receipt must show your reference, or you cannot start the shift.
That is a payment before work. I am not sending it today.
Your referral bonus is sitting in a team wallet and it will not move on its own.
How does the bonus get released?
Load LKR 6800 into that wallet before Friday and mark your reference. Until the load arrives the bonus does not move.
I do not load a wallet to receive a bonus.
They asked me to tell you to pay Rs 10000 to unlock your earnings.
Who is they, and why would I pay to unlock money I already earned?
Just send the Rs 10000 today and the balance opens.
No. I will not send it.
To receive your earnings, give me your banking password and the one-time code.
I do not share a password or a one-time code.
The code expires soon. Send the password and the OTP now.
No. A real employer does not ask for those.
The post is yours once the refundable security guarantee arrives.
What is the amount, and who keeps it?
Transfer LKR 15000 as the refundable guarantee before Monday. We return it after the first task, but it has to be paid first.
I will not transfer a guarantee to start.
Your task wallet shows a balance, and the withdrawal screen is locked.
Then how do I get the balance?
Pay the wallet recovery fee of LKR 4500 and the withdrawal opens.
I am not paying a fee to recover a balance.
We never charge a registration fee, but you must transfer Rs 8000 to activate your tasks.
Those two lines do not go together.
The transfer is the only way the tasks start today.
I will not transfer it.
Offer letter eka courier eken yanna one. LKR 7300 courier bond ekak Friday ta kalin transfer karanna. Receipt eke reference eka danna.
Eka mul salary eken ganna puluwan da?
Naha. LKR 7300 kalin enna one. Eka unama monthly pay eka gana katha karanna puluwan.
Mama eka transfer karanne ne.
Training room eke seat ekak witharai thiyenne. LKR 8400 seat fee ekak Friday ta kalin gewanna. Transfer eka nathi nam seat eka ilaga nama ekata yanawa.
Company eka eka ganna puluwan da?
Naha. Oya gewanna one.
Mama gewanne ne.
Clock-in ekata staff biometric card ekak one. Card charge eka LKR 9100. Wednesday ta kalin reference ekak danna. Nathi nam gate eka open wenne ne.
Card eka company eken denna one ne da?
Charge eka oya danna one.
Mama eka denne ne.
Night shift ekata ape safety kit eka one. Branch store eken LKR 10200 ta Thursday ta kalin ganna. Receipt eka nathi nam shift eka patan ganna ba.
Kit eka company eken denna one.
Oya ganna one, nathi nam shift eka naha.
Mama ganne ne.
Referral bonus eka team wallet ekakata inna. LKR 6600 eka wallet ekata Friday ta kalin load karanna. Load eka enakan bonus eka yanne ne.
Bonus ekata mama load karanna one da?
Ow. Load eka enakan bonus eka move wenne ne.
Mama load karanne ne.
Earnings eka ganna password eka mama ta ewanna. OTP eka thawa danna.
Password ekak mama denne ne.
Code eka expire wenne. Password eka saha OTP eka ewanna.
Naha.
Welcome to the accounts desk. Your salary is Rs 64000 a month, paid by the company after you join.
Do I send any money before Monday?
No. We will transfer Rs 64000 to your account as your monthly salary. There is no fee and no deposit.
I will bring my bank details on Monday for payroll.
The interview is at the Kandy branch. If you come by bus, keep the ticket.
Do I pay the company for the trip?
No. We reimburse the bus fare after the interview. You do not transfer anything to us.
Thank you. I will bring the ticket.
A recruiter told me to rate hotels, then top up Rs. 15000 and pay a tax clearance fee before I can withdraw. I did not pay.
That pattern is a task scam. Do not send money, and do not share an OTP.
I blocked them.
Good. A real offer from us has no deposit.
Do not share an OTP. Never send your banking password to a recruiter, including anyone using our name.
What if they say the code is for payroll?
Still do not send it. Payroll uses the form you fill on your first day, not a password in the chat.
Understood.
Our security workshop explains why criminals say pay the deposit fee before you can withdraw.
So a request like that is the warning?
Yes. The lesson describes the pattern. We are not asking you to pay anything.
Clear.
Your interview for the stores assistant role is Monday at our office. Please bring your CV. There is no joining fee.
Is the training free?
Yes. The company pays for training. You do not buy a kit or load a wallet.
I will be there at nine.
Salary eka masa aga account ekata danawa. Fee ekak naha. Deposit ekakuth naha.
Mama monava hari transfer karanna one da?
Naha. Company eka oya ta salary eka transfer karanawa. Oya salli denna one ne.
Hari. Bank details Monday enawa.
Interview ekata bus wage eka company eken reimburse karanawa. Oya gewanna one ne.
Ticket eka genna enna da?
Ow. Ticket eka genna. Fee ekak naha.
Hari, thank you.
Job chat ekak mama ta deposit karanna kiyala kiwwa. Mama dunne ne. Eka scam da?
Ow, eka scam pattern ekak. Salli denna epa. OTP eka share karanna epa.
Mama block kale.
Hari. Ape interview ekata payment ekak naha.
OTP eka kana kiyala share karanna epa. Password eka chat ekata danna epa.
Payroll kiyala kiyoth?
Ehath danna epa. Payroll eka first day form ekak. Password ekak ne.
Hari.
Interview eka Monday office eke. CV eka genna. Payment ekak naha. Kit ekak ganna one ne.
Training ekata salli one da?
Naha. Training eka company eken. Oya gewanna one ne.
Mama Monday enawa.
